functions.name: ensure_level_badges
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ensure_level_badges(p_athlete_id uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_max_level integer := 1;
  v_changed integer := 0;
begin
  select least(50, greatest(
    1,
    coalesce(p.level, 1),
    coalesce(max(xl.level_after), 1),
    public.level_for_xp(greatest(0, coalesce(sum(xl.xp), 0))::integer)
  ))
  into v_max_level
  from public.profiles p
  left join public.xp_ledger xl on xl.athlete_id = p.id
  where p.id = p_athlete_id
    and p.role = 'athlete'
  group by p.id, p.level;

  if v_max_level is null then
    return 0;
  end if;

  insert into public.athlete_badges (
    athlete_id,
    badge_key,
    badge_type,
    level,
    label,
    icon,
    tone,
    description,
    source,
    source_id,
    metadata
  )
  select
    p_athlete_id,
    'level-' || level_number::text,
    'level',
    level_number,
    badge->>'label',
    badge->>'icon',
    badge->>'tone',
    badge->>'description',
    'xp_level',
    'level:' || level_number::text,
    jsonb_build_object('level', level_number, 'xp_required', public.xp_required_for_level(level_number))
  from generate_series(1, v_max_level) as level_number
  cross join lateral (select public.level_badge(level_number) as badge) b
  on conflict (athlete_id, badge_key) do update
    set label = excluded.label,
        icon = excluded.icon,
        tone = excluded.tone,
        description = excluded.description,
        metadata = public.athlete_badges.metadata || excluded.metadata,
        updated_at = now();

  get diagnostics v_changed = row_count;
  return v_changed;
end;
$function$

functions.name: get_earned_badges
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_earned_badges(p_athlete_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_badges jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
begin
  perform public.ensure_level_badges(p_athlete_id);
  perform public.sync_achievement_badges(p_athlete_id);

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object(
      'key', ab.badge_key,
      'type', ab.badge_type,
      'label', ab.label,
      'icon', ab.icon,
      'description', ab.description,
      'earned_at', ab.earned_at
    )
    order by ab.earned_at, ab.badge_key
  ), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_badges
  from public.athlete_badges ab
  where ab.athlete_id = p_athlete_id
    and ab.badge_type in ('achievement', 'manual');

  return v_badges;
end;
$function$

functions.name: get_xp_summary
sync_achievement_badges
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_achievement_badges(p_athlete_id uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_changed integer := 0;
begin
  insert into public.athlete_badges (
    athlete_id,
    badge_key,
    badge_type,
    label,
    icon,
    description,
    source,
    source_id,
    metadata
  )
  with athlete as (
    select p.id, p.country_code
    from public.profiles p
    where p.id = p_athlete_id
      and p.role = 'athlete'
  ),
  week_data as (
    select b.*
    from athlete a
    cross join lateral public.jkcrew_week_bounds(a.country_code) b
  ),
  percentage_counts as (
    select pa.assignment_id, count(*) as attempt_count
    from public.percentage_attempts pa
    where pa.athlete_id = p_athlete_id
    group by pa.assignment_id
  ),
  assignment_stats as (
    select
      count(*) filter (where a.category = 'one_bang') as one_bang_total,
      count(*) filter (where a.category = 'dialled') as dialled_total,
      count(*) filter (where a.category = 'percentage') as percentage_total,
      count(*) filter (where a.category = 'foam_pit') as foam_total,
      count(*) filter (where a.category = 'bonus') as bonus_total,
      count(*) filter (where a.category = 'one_bang' and ap.completed_at is not null) as one_bang_done,
      count(*) filter (where a.category = 'dialled' and ap.completed_at is not null) as dialled_done,
      count(*) filter (where a.category = 'foam_pit' and ap.completed_at is not null) as foam_done,
      count(*) filter (where a.category = 'bonus' and ap.completed_at is not null) as bonus_done,
      count(*) filter (where a.category = 'percentage' and pc.attempt_count >= 10) as percentage_done
    from week_data wd
    left join public.weekly_trick_assignments a
      on a.athlete_id = p_athlete_id
      and a.week_start = wd.week_start_date
    left join public.assignment_progress ap on ap.assignment_id = a.id
    left join percentage_counts pc on pc.assignment_id = a.id
  ),
  daily_stats as (
    select count(distinct
      case
        when apa.award_key like 'daily-complete:%' then nullif(split_part(apa.award_key, ':', 3), '')
        when apa.award_key like 'daily:%' then nullif(split_part(apa.award_key, ':', 2), '')
        else null
      end
    )::integer as daily_days
    from week_data wd
    join public.assignment_point_awards apa on apa.athlete_id = p_athlete_id
    where apa.created_at >= wd.week_start_ts
      and apa.created_at < wd.next_week_start_ts
      and (apa.award_key like 'daily-complete:%' or apa.award_key like 'daily:%')
  ),
  flags as (
    select
      coalesce(ds.daily_days, 0) >= 7 as daily_all_week,
      coalesce(ast.one_bang_total, 0) > 0 and ast.one_bang_done = ast.one_bang_total as one_bangs_complete,
      coalesce(ast.dialled_total, 0) > 0 and ast.dialled_done = ast.dialled_total as dialled_complete,
      (
        (coalesce(ast.one_bang_total, 0) = 0 or ast.one_bang_done = ast.one_bang_total)
        and (coalesce(ast.dialled_total, 0) = 0 or ast.dialled_done = ast.dialled_total)
        and (coalesce(ast.percentage_total, 0) = 0 or ast.percentage_done = ast.percentage_total)
        and (coalesce(ast.foam_total, 0) = 0 or ast.foam_done = ast.foam_total)
        and (coalesce(ast.bonus_total, 0) = 0 or ast.bonus_done = ast.bonus_total)
        and (coalesce(ast.one_bang_total, 0) + coalesce(ast.dialled_total, 0) + coalesce(ast.percentage_total, 0) + coalesce(ast.foam_total, 0) + coalesce(ast.bonus_total, 0)) > 0
      ) as full_plan_complete
    from assignment_stats ast cross join daily_stats ds
  ),
  earned as (
    select *
    from (values
      ('goat', 'GOAT Badge', '🐐', 'Completed the whole non-daily weekly training plan', (select full_plan_complete from flags)),
      ('cool', 'Cool Person Badge', '😎', 'Completed Daily Tricks every day this week', (select daily_all_week from flags)),
      ('firework', 'Firework Badge', '🎆', 'Completed all One Bangs', (select one_bangs_complete from flags)),
      ('chain', 'Chain Link Badge', '🔗', 'Completed all Dialled tricks', (select dialled_complete from flags))
    ) as badge(key, label, icon, description, earned)
    where earned
  )
  select
    p_athlete_id,
    key,
    'achievement',
    label,
    icon,
    description,
    'auto_progress',
    'achievement:' || key,
    jsonb_build_object('awarded_from', 'current_week_sync')
  from earned
  on conflict (athlete_id, badge_key) do update
    set label = excluded.label,
        icon = excluded.icon,
        description = excluded.description,
        metadata = public.athlete_badges.metadata || excluded.metadata,
        updated_at = now();

  get diagnostics v_changed = row_count;
  return v_changed;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_daily_pb_xp()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if new.role = 'athlete'
     and new.daily_pb_seconds is not null
     and (old.daily_pb_seconds is null or new.daily_pb_seconds < old.daily_pb_seconds) then
    perform public.sync_xp_award(
      new.id,
      'daily_pb',
      'daily_pb:' || new.id::text || ':' || new.daily_pb_seconds::text,
      15,
      'Beat Daily Tricks PB',
      null,
      null,
      'Daily Tricks PB',
      '',
      null,
      jsonb_build_object('previous_pb_seconds', old.daily_pb_seconds, 'new_pb_seconds', new.daily_pb_seconds)
    );
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

functions.name: sync_percentage_attempt_xp

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_percentage_attempt_xp()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  perform public.sync_percentage_xp_for_assignment(coalesce(new.assignment_id, old.assignment_id));
  return coalesce(new, old);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_level_badges(p_athlete_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_current_level integer := 1;
  v_badges jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
begin
  perform public.ensure_level_badges(p_athlete_id);

  select greatest(
    1,
    coalesce(p.level, 1),
    coalesce(max(ab.level) filter (where ab.badge_type = 'level'), 1)
  )
  into v_current_level
  from public.profiles p
  left join public.athlete_badges ab on ab.athlete_id = p.id
  where p.id = p_athlete_id
    and p.role = 'athlete'
  group by p.id, p.level;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(
    (
      case
        when ab.badge_key is not null then jsonb_build_object(
          'key', ab.badge_key,
          'type', ab.badge_type,
          'level', level_number,
          'label', ab.label,
          'icon', ab.icon,
          'tone', ab.tone,
          'description', ab.description
        )
        else public.level_badge(level_number)
      end
    ) || jsonb_build_object(
      'unlocked', ab.badge_key is not null,
      'current', level_number = v_current_level,
      'xp_required', public.xp_required_for_level(level_number),
      'earned_at', ab.earned_at
    )
    order by level_number
  ), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_badges
  from generate_series(1, 50) as level_number
  left join public.athlete_badges ab
    on ab.athlete_id = p_athlete_id
    and ab.badge_key = 'level-' || level_number::text;

  return v_badges;
end;
$function$
